decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's fluid-handling and machine-tool offer, supported by in-house R&D and modular engineering capabilities, this product is likely to be retained and improved rather than withdrawn.
This hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's established filtration knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and management would be inclined to keep it on the market.
This gravity band coolant filter is strongly related to the firm's core filtration systems and service business, making it a good candidate to keep despite limited later website evidence.
